meta_description: Iconic 30A Showhouse with Gulf views, private pool, rooftop lounge, elevator, and private beach access—luxury living between Rosemary and Alys Beach.
description_expanded: 30A Showhouse Features - High-end Everything! This is the best house on 30A according to Atlanta Homes and Lifestyles Magazine - Gulf views from the rooftop outdoor lounge and perch - 30-second walk to the private neighborhood beach. Only shared with 19 other homes. - Incredible private pool off the 2nd floor main living area. rooms_guidance: 3rd Floor Deluxe King Suite 1 | Smart TV, Private sitting room with Smart TV (private office is not available), air circulation tower, ensuite spa bath with soaking tub, large walk-in shower with dual shower heads, and Two water closets. You won’t have to share!
3rd Floor King Suite 2 | Smart TV, air circulation tower, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor Guest Suite 1 | Smart TV, sleeps 4 in two Queen beds, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
1st Floor King Suite 3 | Smart TV, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
1st Floor Guest Room 2 | Smart TV, sleeps 2 in a Queen bed, adjacent to hallway entrance to shared full bath with a combination shower/tub
1st Floor Bunk Room | Sleeps 4 in two Twin over Twin bunks, doorway curtain for privacy, adjacent to hallway entrance to shared full bath with a combination shower/tub
